name: leaf
description: Generative UI: the agent builds the page your task needs, writes new widgets when the project calls for them, and answers your comments and edits over a messaging and collaboration bus.

hooks_module.title: Watch pages with a hooks module (early access)
hooks_module.description: Keep Leaf's watch between turns in a Claude Code hooks module rather than a background Stop hook, so a page's input still reaches the session after you interrupt a turn. Needs a Claude Code that loads hooks modules.
